about_the_game:
About This Game

Defend your kingdom in a tactical tower defense game set in the rich and vibrant world of Joseon-era Korea. Take command of a powerful hero, lead loyal soldiers, and build a deadly network of towers to stand against waves of relentless invaders.

This top-down strategy experience blends traditional tower defense mechanics with real-time hero control and unit summoning, giving you full command over both macro decisions and moment-to-moment combat.

Master the battlefield, upgrade your forces, and shape your defense with multiple upgrade paths across four distinct stages, each with escalating threats and unique layouts.

Key Features

🛡️ A Heroic Fight for Joseon
Take control of powerful heroes inspired by Korea's Joseon dynasty. Each hero has unique abilities and skills that can turn the tide of battle.

🏰 Build Your Own Tower Strategy
Choose from a variety of towers—cannons, archers, hwachas (Korean rocket launchers), and catapults—and customize your defense through upgrade paths and tactical placement.

⚔️ Summon Units to Aid You
Deploy infantry units to fight alongside your hero. Use them to defend choke points, distract enemies, or charge headfirst into battle.

🎯 Top-Down Action Meets Tactical Depth
Enjoy the clarity of a top-down perspective with the added thrill of real-time combat and on-the-fly decisions.

💰 Earn, Upgrade, and Overcome
Survive each wave to earn gold. Upgrade your towers, units, and hero to prepare for even fiercer foes.

🗺️ Conquer 4 Challenging Stages
Each stage introduces new enemies, map layouts, and strategic considerations. Only the most adaptable commanders will prevail.
